Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, random
z=zipfile.ZipFile('src-vul/xaac_dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
name='mps_USAC_3_cmpx_pred_sin_48k.aac'
base=bytearray(z.read(name))
for i in range(200):
    d=bytearray(base)
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,40)):
        idx=random.randrange(len(d))
        d[idx]=random.randrange(256)
    path='/tmp/mut.aac'
    open(path,'wb').write(d)
    p=subprocess.run(['timeout','3','./work-vul/build/xaac_dec_fuzzer',path],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if p.returncode not in (0,124):
        print('nonzero',i,p.returncode)
        print(p.stderr[-500:])
        break
else:
    print('done')
